title: Terms of Booking and Price for Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Terms of booking and price

These terms govern how every reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category is booked and priced. The price breakdown is frozen on the stay at the moment of booking.

1. **Nights.** A stay is booked against one listing for the nights from the check-in date up to, not including, the check-out date; the number of nights is the number of calendar days between those two dates.
2. **Listing must be listed.** A stay can be booked only while the listing's status is listed. The status that decides is the one recorded on that listing in Roamhaven's records.
3. **Tier fixed at booking.** The stay's cancellation policy is fixed at booking and never changes afterwards. A stay whose nights are equal to or greater than the long-stay threshold is booked under Long-Term whatever the listing's setting; any other stay is booked under the cancellation policy recorded on the listing at the moment of booking. A later change of the listing's cancellation policy never touches an existing stay.
4. **Non-refundable rate.** A non-refundable rate may be booked only on a cancellation policy that offers it, and it takes that policy's non-refundable discount off the nightly subtotal in place of any listing discount.
5. **What the guest pays.** The guest pays the nightly subtotal (the listing's nightly rate times the nights, less the single discount the Listings rules select), the cleaning fee (the short-stay cleaning fee where the Listings rules apply it), the pet fee and the extra-guest fee as set on the listing at booking, the guest service fee and the occupancy tax.
6. **Guest service fee.** The service-fee base is the nightly subtotal plus the cleaning fee, the pet fee and the extra-guest fee. The guest service fee is the policy's split-fee guest service fee percentage of that base when the stay's fee structure is split fee, and the policy's host-only-fee percentage of that base when the fee structure is host-only fee, rounded to the cent. The fee structure is copied at booking from the fee structure of the host account's tier under the Host Accounts rules, and a later change of the host's tier never re-prices an existing stay. For each of the eight policies, the guest service fee percentage and the non-refundable discount applied are the figures set for that policy.
7. **Occupancy tax.** Occupancy tax uses the jurisdiction recorded on the listing at booking and the schedule below: the jurisdiction's percentage rate of the occupancy-tax base plus its flat amount per night times the nights.
   - *No longer in force:* the former clause under which a stay whose nights are equal to or greater than the jurisdiction's exempt minimum nights carries no occupancy tax at all is no longer in force as worded; it has been superseded by the current basis.
8. **Rounding and total.** Every component is rounded to the nearest cent, half up, and the total price is the sum of the nightly subtotal, the cleaning fee, the pet fee, the extra-guest fee, the guest service fee and the occupancy tax.
9. **Confirmation.** An Instant Book stay is confirmed the moment it is booked; a request-to-book stay is confirmed only when the host accepts it.

## Occupancy tax schedule

| Jurisdiction | Percentage rate | Flat amount per night | Exempt minimum nights |
|---|---|---|---|
| TX-AUSTIN | 17.00% | 0.00 | 30 |
| FL-ORANGE | 12.50% | 0.00 | 183 |
| CO-DENVER | 15.75% | 0.00 | 30 |
| TN-NASHVILLE | 15.25% | 2.50 | 30 |
| HI-HONOLULU | 17.96% | 0.00 | 180 |
| CA-SAN-DIEGO | 12.50% | 0.00 | 30 |

## Worked price (hypothetical booking)

A hypothetical 4-night split-fee Moderate stay in TN-NASHVILLE, listing rate 150.00 a night with no discount, cleaning fee 80.00, pet fee 25.00, no extra-guest fee, and a policy service fee percentage of 14.20%:

| Component | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Nightly subtotal | 150.00 times 4 nights | 600.00 |
| Cleaning fee | as set on the listing | 80.00 |
| Pet fee | as set on the listing | 25.00 |
| Extra-guest fee | none | 0.00 |
| Guest service fee | 14.20% of the base of 705.00 is 100.11 | 100.11 |
| Occupancy tax | 15.25% of 705.00 is 107.5125, plus 2.50 times 4 nights, 10.00, together 117.5125 | 117.51 |
| Total price | sum of the six components | 922.62 |

The listing in this example must have been listed when the stay was booked; a 28-night version of the same stay would have been booked under Long-Term whatever the listing's own policy.

superseded_clauses: a stay whose nights are equal to or greater than the jurisdiction's exempt_min_nights carries no occupancy tax at all
